mapper.sql: select o.order_id,o.order_no,o.member_id,o.status,o.payment_status,o.risk_status,o.idempotency_key, o.product_amount,o.shipping_fee,o.discount_amount,o.payable_amount, o.receiver_name,o.receiver_phone,o.receiver_province,o.receiver_city, o.receiver_district,o.receiver_detail_address,o.remark,o.cancel_reason,o.version, o.create_time,o.pay_time,o.close_time,o.update_time, case when o.status='AFTER_SALE' or latest_after_sale.after_sale_id is not null then 'AFTER_SALE' else o.status end as display_status, coalesce(( select count(1) from mall_item_after_sale active_after_sale where active_after_sale.order_id=o.order_id and active_after_sale.member_id=o.member_id and active_after_sale.status in () ),0) as active_after_sale_count, latest_after_sale.after_sale_id as latest_after_sale_id, latest_after_sale.type as latest_after_sale_type, latest_after_sale.status as latest_after_sale_status, latest_after_sale.update_time as latest_after_sale_update_time from mall_order o left join mall_item_after_sale latest_after_sale on latest_after_sale.after_sale_id=( select max(candidate.after_sale_id) from mall_item_after_sale candidate where candidate.order_id=o.order_id and candidate.member_id=o.member_id and candidate.status in () )
mapper.select: select from mall_order where order_id=#{orderId} and member_id=#{memberId}

select i.order_item_id,i.order_id,i.sku_id,i.sku_code,i.product_name,i.sku_name, i.product_image,i.unit_price,i.quantity,i.line_amount,i.create_time from mall_order_item i join mall_order o on o.order_id=i.order_id where i.order_id=#{orderId} and o.member_id=#{memberId} order by i.order_item_id

select l.operation_id,l.order_id,l.order_no,l.from_status,l.to_status,l.operator_type, l.operator_id,l.remark,l.request_id,l.create_time from mall_order_operation_log l join mall_order o on o.order_id=l.order_id where l.order_id=#{orderId} and o.member_id=#{memberId} order by l.operation_id

select order_id,order_no,member_id,status,payment_status,risk_status,idempotency_key, product_amount,shipping_fee,discount_amount,payable_amount, receiver_name,receiver_phone,receiver_province,receiver_city, receiver_district,receiver_detail_address,remark,cancel_reason,version, create_time,pay_time,close_time,update_time from mall_order where order_id=#{orderId} and member_id=#{memberId} for update

select order_id,order_no,member_id,status,payment_status,idempotency_key, product_amount,shipping_fee,discount_amount,payable_amount, receiver_name,receiver_phone,receiver_province,receiver_city, receiver_district,receiver_detail_address,remark,cancel_reason,version, create_time,close_time,update_time from mall_order where status='PENDING_PAYMENT' and ( (payment_status='UNPAID' and create_time <= #{unpaidCutoffTime}) or (payment_status='PAYING' and create_time <= #{payingCutoffTime}) ) order by create_time,order_id limit #{limit}

select order_id,order_no,member_id,status,payment_status,idempotency_key, product_amount,shipping_fee,discount_amount,payable_amount, receiver_name,receiver_phone,receiver_province,receiver_city, receiver_district,receiver_detail_address,remark,cancel_reason,version,create_time,close_time,update_time from mall_order where member_id=#{memberId} and idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: update mall_order set status=#{toStatus},cancel_reason=#{cancelReason}, close_time=case when #{toStatus} in ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') then now() else close_time end, version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status=#{fromStatus} and payment_status='UNPAID'

update mall_order set status='CLOSED',payment_status='FAILED',cancel_reason=#{cancelReason}, close_time=now(),version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='PENDING_PAYMENT' and payment_status=#{paymentStatus}
update mall_order set payment_status='PAYING',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='PENDING_PAYMENT' and payment_status='UNPAID'
update mall_order set payment_status='UNPAID',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='PENDING_PAYMENT' and payment_status='PAYING'

update mall_order set status='PENDING_SHIPMENT',payment_status='PAID',pay_time=now(), version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='PENDING_PAYMENT' and payment_status='PAYING'
update mall_order set payment_status='REFUNDING',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='CLOSED' and payment_status='FAILED'
update mall_order set payment_status='REFUNDED',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='CLOSED' and payment_status='REFUNDING'
update mall_order set status='SHIPPED',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='PENDING_SHIPMENT' and payment_status='PAID'
update mall_order set status='COMPLETED',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='SHIPPED' and payment_status='PAID'
update mall_order set status='AFTER_SALE',payment_status='REFUNDING',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status=#{fromStatus} and payment_status='PAID'
update mall_order set payment_status='REFUNDED',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='AFTER_SALE' and payment_status='REFUNDING'
update mall_order set status=#{originalStatus},payment_status='PAID',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and status='AFTER_SALE' and payment_status='REFUNDING'
update mall_order set risk_status='PASSED',version=version+1,update_time=now() where order_id=#{orderId} and risk_status='PENDING_CHECK'
